admin.overview.awaiting.open_reports.description: Name of the tile of the moderation overview with how many reports are open; the tile links to the report queue.

admin.overview.awaiting.pending_appeals.description: Name of the tile of the moderation overview with how many appeals of moderation actions await a decision; the tile links to the appeals.

admin.overview.awaiting.pending_registra.description: Name of the tile of the moderation overview with how many registrations await approval; the tile links to the registrations.

admin.overview.awaiting.report_wait.description: Name of the tile of the moderation overview with how long the oldest open report has waited; the tile links to the report queue, oldest first.

admin.overview.awaiting.report_wait.days.description: Value of the longest report wait tile: whole days.

admin.overview.awaiting.report_wait.hour.description: Value of the longest report wait tile: whole hours.

admin.overview.awaiting.report_wait.minu.description: Value of the longest report wait tile: whole minutes.

admin.overview.awaiting.report_wait.none.description: Value of the longest report wait tile when no report is open.

admin.overview.awaiting.report_wait.stat.description: Word beside a warning icon on the longest report wait tile when the oldest open report has waited a day or more.

admin.overview.awaiting.status.description: Word beside a warning icon on a tile of the moderation overview whose queue has items waiting.

admin.overview.awaiting.title.description: Heading of the region of the moderation overview with a tile for each queue: open reports, registrations, appeals.

admin.overview.awaiting.unavailable.defaultMessage: The counts could not be loaded. Open a queue from the menu.
admin.overview.awaiting.unavailable.description: Shown in the region of the moderation overview when the counts of the queues could not be loaded.

admin.overview.first_reports.all.description: Link under the reports to handle first on the moderation overview, to the whole report queue.

admin.overview.first_reports.description.defaultMessage: Legal reports first, then the ones waiting longest.
admin.overview.first_reports.description.description: Note under the heading of the reports to handle first on the moderation overview: how they are ordered.

admin.overview.first_reports.title.description: Heading of the region of the moderation overview with the open reports to handle first, each with its category, its wait and who handles it.

admin.overview.first_reports.unavailable.defaultMessage: The reports could not be loaded.
admin.overview.first_reports.unavailable.description: Shown in the reports to handle first on the moderation overview when the reports could not be loaded.

admin.overview.health.failed_jobs.description: Name of the tile of the administration overview with how many jobs failed for good; the tile links to the failed jobs.

admin.overview.health.failed_jobs.status.description: Word beside a warning icon on the failed jobs tile when some jobs failed.

admin.overview.health.job_wait.description: Name of the tile of the administration overview with how long the job queue has kept its oldest due job waiting.

admin.overview.health.job_wait.days.description: Value of the longest job wait tile: whole days.

admin.overview.health.job_wait.hours.description: Value of the longest job wait tile: whole hours.

admin.overview.health.job_wait.minutes.description: Value of the longest job wait tile: whole minutes.

admin.overview.health.job_wait.none.description: Value of the longest job wait tile when no due job waits.

admin.overview.health.job_wait.status.description: Word beside a warning icon on the longest job wait tile when jobs wait 15 minutes or more.

admin.overview.health.none.defaultMessage: Your roles watch nothing that this overview shows. Open a screen from the menu.
admin.overview.health.none.description: Shown on the administration overview to a user whose roles allow administration screens but neither the job queue nor the errors.

admin.overview.health.open_errors.description: Name of the tile of the administration overview with how many error groups are open; the tile links to the errors.

admin.overview.health.open_errors.more.description: Value of the open errors tile when there are more groups than the first page: the page's count and a plus.

admin.overview.health.open_errors.status.description: Word beside a warning icon on the open errors tile when some groups are open.

admin.overview.health.title.description: Heading of the region of the administration overview with tiles for the failed jobs, the job wait and the open errors.

admin.overview.value.loading.description: Value of a tile of an overview while its number loads.

admin.overview.value.unavailable.description: Value of a tile of an overview whose number could not be loaded.
